features.name: front-foundation
features.description: Astro 5 scaffold with i18n (en/es/ca), design tokens + BaseLayout/ThemeToggle/Monogram, typed trilingual content collections (11 projects), projects index with stack filter and detail pages.

features.name: site-pages
features.description: Home (hero, pillars, featured strip, HeaderNav), experience timeline, skills grid, about + contact, footer, 404, CV page with downloads and print styles.

features.name: seo-analytics
features.description: Full SEO component (OG/Twitter/hreflang/canonical), JSON-LD Person + BreadcrumbList, robots.txt, generated sitemap, llms.txt + llms-full.txt build endpoints, optional GoatCounter.

features.name: deploy

features.name: qa-gate
features.description: Playwright smoke suite (render, routing, i18n), Lighthouse CI gate >=95 x4, final content QA (trilingual, no phone, live links), v0.1.0 tag.
